In the order of execution, when do custom validation rules run relative to Apex before triggers?
Validation rules do not run on trigger-modified records
Before-save flows and before triggers run first; custom validation rules run after them. A before trigger can therefore make a record fail validation.
Which automation runs FIRST when a record is saved?
Before-save flows run before Apex before triggers. They are also the cheapest way to set a field on the record being saved, because no extra DML is issued.
Relative to Apex after triggers, when do after-save record-triggered flows run?
After triggers run first, then assignment, auto-response and escalation steps, then after-save record-triggered flows — all still inside the same transaction.
When do duplicate rules run relative to custom validation rules?
Custom validation rules run, then duplicate rules, then the record is saved (but not committed) and after triggers fire.
What can a before-save (fast field update) record-triggered flow NOT do?
Update fields on the record that triggered it
Create, update or delete other records
A before-save flow only changes the triggering record, which is what makes it fast. Anything touching other records belongs in an after-save flow.
Which job needs an after-save flow rather than a before-save one?
Defaulting a field on the record being saved
Creating a related task that needs the new record’s Id
Uppercasing a text field before save
Copying one field to another on the same record
The record has an Id only once it is saved, and touching related records needs after-save. Same-record field updates are cheaper before save.
What does a scheduled path in a record-triggered flow do?
Runs part of the flow at a time relative to the trigger or a date on the record
Runs the whole flow every night
Retries a failed element on a schedule
A scheduled path runs later — say, three days before a contract’s end date — and re-checks the entry conditions when it runs if configured to.
Which type of flow can show screens to a user?
Only screen flows have a user interface. The others run in the background with no screens.
How is an autolaunched flow with no trigger started?
By Apex, another flow, the REST API, or a button or action
Only from the Flow Builder debug window
An autolaunched flow with no trigger runs when something calls it: Apex, a subflow element, the REST API, or a quick action.
What should a team do with its remaining workflow rules and Process Builder processes?
Keep building new ones in them
Migrate them to Flow — Salesforce has ended support for both
Salesforce retired workflow rules and Process Builder in favour of Flow; the Migrate to Flow tool converts many of them.
Why should Create/Update Records elements sit outside a loop in a flow?
Flow does not allow them inside loops
Each one runs per iteration and can exhaust the transaction’s DML limits
Flows share Apex governor limits. Build a collection inside the loop and write it once after the loop — the flow version of bulkification.
In a record-triggered flow, how do you read a field’s value from before the update?
$Record__Prior holds the record as it was before the update; $Record holds it as it is being saved. Comparing them is how a flow reacts only to a real change.
What is a fault path in a flow?
A connector that runs when an element fails, so the error can be handled
A path that runs when no Decision outcome matches
The path a flow takes when it is deactivated
Without a fault path, an element failure ends the flow with an unhandled error email. With one, the flow can log, notify or show a message.
What happens to a record while it is pending in an approval process?
It is locked, so only admins and the current approver can edit it
It is moved to a queue
Submission locks the record by default so it cannot change under the approver. Final approval or rejection actions decide whether it stays locked.
Which flow type runs when a platform event message is received?
A platform event-triggered flow subscribes to an event and runs for each message, in its own transaction.
To reuse the same logic from several flows
To run the logic as another user
To make the flow run asynchronously
A subflow keeps shared logic in one place, so a fix happens once. It runs in the same transaction and shares its limits.
A Get Records element set to "Only the first record" stores its result as what?
One record variable. "All records" stores a collection — the setting decides which kind of variable the element can fill.
What does the Assignment element do in a flow?
Sets or changes the values of flow variables
Assigns a record to a new owner in the database
Assignment works on variables only. Nothing reaches the database until an Update or Create Records element runs.
What is the "Run Asynchronously" path of an after-save flow for?
Work that should run after the transaction commits, such as callouts to external systems
Making the flow run before triggers
Running the flow in system mode
The asynchronous path runs after the save commits, so it can call external systems and its failure does not roll back the record.
Which declarative field totals child records onto a parent without any automation?
A roll-up summary field, on the master of a master-detail relationship
A formula field on a lookup
Roll-up summary fields (COUNT, SUM, MIN, MAX) need master-detail. Over a lookup, the total has to be maintained by a flow or Apex.
What does "Only when a record is updated to meet the condition requirements" do on a record-triggered flow?
Runs the flow only on the save that makes the conditions become true
Runs the flow on every save while the conditions are true
Runs the flow only on insert
It fires on the transition — false before, true now — so a flow does not repeat every time an already-matching record is edited.
When does a schedule-triggered flow run?
At a set time and frequency, optionally once for each record that matches a filter
When a user clicks a button
Set a start time, a frequency and optionally an object and filter; the flow then runs per matching record in batches.
What does the Loop element do in a flow?
Steps through a collection one item at a time
Each iteration sets the loop variable to the next item; work for the whole collection belongs after the loop.
What does a Decision element do?
Sends the flow down one outcome based on conditions
Outcomes are evaluated in order; the first one whose conditions are met is taken, otherwise the default.
What does the Collection Filter element return?
A new collection holding only the items that meet its conditions
It replaces the loop-and-decision pattern for narrowing a collection, without touching the original.
When is a flow formula resource evaluated?
Only at the end of the flow
A formula reflects the current values of whatever it refers to at the moment it is used.
What does "Available for input" on a flow variable mean?
Its value can be set when the flow is launched — by a subflow, Apex, a page or a URL
Users can type into it on any screen
Input variables are how a caller passes values in; output variables are how it reads results back.
What do reactive screen components do?
Update on the same screen as the user changes other components
A component can reference another's value on the same screen, so totals and visibility change without clicking Next.
What does running a flow in "system context without sharing" mean?
It runs as a guest user
It ignores the running user's permissions and sharing
System context can see and change records the user could not, so it should be used deliberately.
In which context do record-triggered flows run?
Record-triggered flows always run in system context, whoever saved the record.
How many versions of a flow can be active at the same time?
Activating a version deactivates the previous one; paused interviews keep the version they started on.
What does Flow Trigger Explorer show?
Every Apex trigger in the org
Which record-triggered flows run on an object, and in what order
It lists flows by object and trigger, before-save and after-save, with their trigger order.
How do you control the order of several record-triggered flows on the same object and trigger?
Create them in the desired order
Set the Trigger Order value on each flow
Flows run in ascending Trigger Order. Give every flow on the object a value, so the order is decided rather than implied.
Can a record-triggered flow run when a record is deleted?
Only after the Recycle Bin is emptied
A record-triggered flow can be set to run when a record is deleted, before the delete happens.
Multi-step, multi-person processes organised in stages, with work items assigned to people
Orchestrations sequence flows and human steps across stages and track who has to do what next.
What can the steps of an approval process do?
Route a record to different approvers, in sequence, based on criteria
Each step has entry criteria and approvers; a record can go through several before final approval.
When do an approval process's initial submission actions run?
As soon as the record is submitted for approval
Initial submission actions — such as locking the record or updating a status field — run on submission.
What does an email alert used by automation consist of?
A free-text message typed at run time
An email template plus the recipients defined on the alert
The alert is a reusable definition; flows and approval processes call it.
Where does the Send Custom Notification action reach users?
In the desktop notification tray and as mobile push notifications
A custom notification type defines the channels; the action sends to users, groups or queues.
How does a flow call Apex?
Through an Apex action backed by an @InvocableMethod
One invocable method per class appears as an action; it receives a list so the call stays bulk-safe.
Defining the input and output fields of a class an invocable method uses
It lets a flow pass several named values into and out of Apex in one call.
Do flows count against the transaction's governor limits?
Yes — they share the same limits as Apex in that transaction
A record-triggered flow and an Apex trigger on the same save draw from one set of limits.
What does a Pause element do?
Waits until a time or a platform event before the flow resumes
The flow interview is saved and resumes in a new transaction when the condition is met.
How do you put a screen flow on a Lightning record page?
Paste its URL into a field
Add it to the page layout
Add the Flow component in Lightning App Builder
The Flow component can pass the record's Id and other values into the flow's input variables.
A screen flow on a record page needs the current record's Id. What variable should it have?
A variable named currentRecord, available for output
A text variable named recordId, available for input
The Lightning page passes the record Id into an input variable called recordId.
How can a screen component reject bad input before the user moves on?
A validation rule on the flow
Validate Input on the component, with a formula and an error message
A Decision after the screen only
The formula must be TRUE for the input to be accepted; otherwise the message appears and the user stays on the screen.
Can an Update Records element change records without a Get Records first?
Yes — it can find records by conditions and set field values directly
No, it always needs a record variable
"Specify conditions to identify records" updates every matching record in one statement.
In a record-triggered flow's conditions, which operator checks that a field changed in this save?
Is Changed compares the new value with the prior one, so a flow can react only to a real change.
How many lead assignment rules can be active at once?
One active rule, with ordered entries; the first matching entry assigns the lead.
An email reply to the person who submitted a lead or case
Auto-response rules choose a template based on criteria and reply to the submitter of a Web-to-Lead or Web-to-Case form or email.
Who receives the email about an unhandled flow error by default?
The user who last modified the flow
Process Automation Settings can send these emails to Apex exception recipients instead.
What does the Migrate to Flow tool do?
Converts workflow rules and processes into record-triggered flows
It creates an equivalent flow to test and activate, after which the old automation can be switched off.
In an Assignment element, what does the "Add" operator do to a record collection?
Inserts the record into the database
Appends the item to the collection
Building a collection in a loop and saving it once afterwards is the bulk-safe pattern.
What is a text template resource for?
Formatted text with merge fields, such as an email body
Text templates can be plain or rich text, and resolve their merge fields when used.
What does the Roll Back Records element do?
Undoes the record changes made so far in the current transaction
Restores records from the Recycle Bin
Reverts the flow to its previous version
Typically used on a fault path so a half-finished set of changes is not left behind.
How does a flow publish a platform event?
With a Create Records element on the platform event object
Creating a record of the event object publishes the message to its subscribers.
When debugging a flow in Flow Builder, how can you run it without keeping its data changes?
Debug with rollback, so changes are undone after the run
Rollback mode lets you watch a real run against real data and leave the data as it was.
What does the Collection Sort element do?
Orders a collection by one or more fields, and can keep only the first items
Sorting and limiting in the flow avoids another query when you need, say, the latest five records.
Why is a Get Records element inside a loop a problem?
It runs a query per iteration and can exhaust the SOQL query limit
Get Records cannot read in loops
It returns no data in loops
Query once before the loop for everything you need, then work from the collection.
On a flow screen, what controls whether the user can go back to the previous screen?
The screen's footer settings for the Previous button
Each screen decides which navigation buttons appear — Previous, Next or Finish, and Pause — so going back can be switched off where it would repeat an action.
